title: Forbidden Arcana
description: Forbidden Arcana adds a magic system including spells and infusion inspired by Lucraft and JJK.
body:
Forbidden arcana is a magic and spells mod that revolves around two central systems, spells and infusion. Spells function in a similar manner to Lucraft: Core by lucraft, the spells are managed in their own independent gui element allowing a display of spell icon and cooldown. Infusion works in it's own entirely unique way. Compatible items with notches can be filled with forbidden arcana during rituals. Forbidden arcana infusion allows players to infinitely scale thier item's power enhancing stats such as, speed, damage, mining speed, attack speed, defense, health and more. Infusion uses a formula that decreases in power gain the higher the forbidden arcana is to allow it to maintain a balanced system while still remaining infinite. Certain tools and gear will also gain abilities as they progress through forbidden arcana levels.

# Current State/Function:
- Basic spell gui and test spells
# Upcoming Features:
- More refined spell system
- Spell element and element weaknesses
- Infusion
- Forbidden arcana collection
- Code optimization

Current versions are in very early beta and are currently posted for testing purposes don't expect a semi complete or even decent experience yet
